summary: Super Group (SGHC) Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 11, 2026, containing a press release of its Q1 2026 financial results. The filing reports revenue of $612M, profit of $86M, Adjusted EBITDA of $152M, and reaffirms FY2026 guidance of $2.55B revenue and $680M Adjusted EBITDA. It also announces a change in reportable segments from Betway and Spin to Africa and International. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring is disclosed. This is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer.
